for target pruning rates equal to 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% and 50%

metadata.evidence: prunes and trains the model iteratively for 200 epochs
the model is fine-tuned for an additional 10 epochs
Simply move the convert_to_torchscript.py script inside the EResFD-main/ directory and run it.
move the created lite_scripted_model.ptl to your android application`s asset folder
The EResFD.java file contains a java class that can be used in order to load the model from the assets folder and use it for inference.
